name: Cloak of Water
body:
School transmutation [water]; Level druid 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 6

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration 1 hour/level (D)

Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

You surround the touched creature in a sea-green glow.

While underwater the target gains the benefits of blur, freedom of movement, and water breathing.

Additionally, they do not take damage from pressure. While out of the water, the target only gains the blur effect.
